name: bill-split
description: 智能账单分摊，支持多人多种分摊规则与实时结算预览
interaction: Users drag item cards onto diners' avatars to assign dishes, with real-time per-person totals updating instantly. Custom split rules—equal, percentage, or exact amounts—can be mixed within a single bill. A shared live preview lets all participants see and confirm their share before finalizing.
